spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes current asks on existing live eBay listings for one run. It never creates a listing and it does not save a pricing profile, seller baseline, or durable override. A later automatic eBay reprice can replace the ask.

Call with dryRun true first. A preview changes no eBay price. A preview with itemIds answers inline and writes no job. Any other preview queues a preview job, and its counts are final only when spellbook_ebay_job_status shows state complete and dryRun true. An explicit dryRun false queues a job; a returned jobId means planning started, not that eBay has accepted every price.
The workspace owner check and agent_marketplace_publish kill switch run before the route. The tool sends no eBay credential and cannot select another workspace.

The backend reprices only existing eBay listings and preserves its live-listing filter, no-op tolerance, market-price requirements, price locks, SKU floors, grouped-offer safety, stale-input revalidation and per-item failure reporting. Rows without a usable market target remain skipped with counts in the preview or job.
Use itemIds for a small exact set. binId, acquisitionSource and setCodes narrow the existing backend selector; omitted selectors cover all eligible live eBay listings in the workspace.
Read spellbook_ebay_job_status after apply. A terminal job state alone does not prove every row changed; inspect each item state and failure reason.

description: Preview or reprice existing live eBay listings in one seller workspace using a market multiplier and optional floor. This is a one-run marketplace override: it changes current eBay asks, creates no listing, and saves no pricing profile or durable override. Preview first with the default dryRun true. A preview with itemIds returns its counts at once. Any other preview returns state planning and a jobId, so read its counts with spellbook_ebay_job_status. An explicit dryRun false queues an async reprice job. Read that job with spellbook_ebay_job_status until each affected listing reaches its terminal state.

acquisitionSource.description: Restrict the run to one exact acquisition source. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

binId.description: Restrict the run to one exact inventory bin. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

dryRun.description: True previews the listings and counts with no marketplace change. False queues the reprice job. Defaults to true; applying requires explicit false.

floorUsd.description: Optional minimum ask in USD. Existing backend floors and locks can still raise the resulting ask.

itemIds.description: Restrict the run to these exact listed Item ids from spellbook_inventory_items_query. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

multiplier.description: Market price multiplier for the selected listings, such as 0.96 for 96% of market. Required.

setCodes.description: Restrict the run to these set codes. Omit for every live eBay listing in the workspace.

skipIfWithinPercent.description: Skip an existing ask already within this percentage of the target. Defaults to 2.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose existing eBay listings to reprice. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_reprice
